summary: 82-year-old hiker broke his hip in a fall on the Mt. of the Holy Cross summit and activated a PLB; HAATS Black Hawk hoist team airlifted him to Vail Valley Medical Center; out ~8:30 p.m.
location: Mt. of the Holy Cross summit
notes: Jul-Aug-2015 VMRG mission digest; resolves the parked 2015-07-09 HAATS hoist lead. Distinct from id 2564 (Mt. Blanca lost hikers, same date).
